name: American Legion Post 109
audience: Players must be 18 or older. Guests are signed in, and after three visits a guest must join the post.
schedule_note: The post holds bingo on Sundays during its bingo season and does not post the season dates. Call before you go.
notes: Card sales start at 5 p.m. The post says games begin around 6 p.m., once the pots are counted.
Bingo can be called off for bad weather.

sources.scope: Post bingo page: every Sunday during bingo season, card sales 5 p.m., games tentatively 6 p.m., address, phone, age and guest rules

name: Penbrook American Legion Post 730
schedule_note: Bingo is on the 1st and 3rd Thursday of each month, not every Thursday. Call before you go.
notes: The post has used different dates in January. Check its page or call in January.

sources.scope: Post bingo page: 1st and 3rd Thursdays at 6 p.m., open to the public; address and phone from the page footer

name: Tylersport Fire Company
schedule_note: Bingo days come from Salford Township's page for the fire company. Days and times can change, so call before you go.
notes: For bingo questions, ask for extension 171.
source_label: Salford Township: Tylersport Fire Company bingo

sources.scope: Township page: bingo every Tuesday, doors 4:30 p.m., games 6:30 p.m., address and phone (extension 171)

name: Collinsburg Volunteer Fire Company
schedule_note: Bingo days come from the group's own website. Days and times can change, so call before you go.
notes: Early bird games start at 7 p.m. and regular games at 7:15 p.m.

sources.scope: Fire company bingo page: every Thursday and Saturday evening, early birds 7 p.m., regular games 7:15 p.m., phone; address from the contact section
